facts.fact: The Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia invited stakeholders to send written submissions by 29 August 2025 on the Minister of ICT's proposed policy directive to raise the minimum broadband speed, following consultations held by the Ministry on 21 May 2025 and by CRAN on 11 July 2025 (the notice gives the 29 August 2025 deadline and no notice date).
facts.system: Proposed Policy Directive to increase the minimum Broadband Speed
